title: EmDash Apply finds an imported picture by its file name, including a name the media library renamed, not by its row: JA Restaurant and JA Diner keep every picture on a fresh import and after an Apply that moved rows
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: node --test --test-reporter=tap packages/cms/tracy-emdash-theme-restaurant/tests/personalize-imported-pictures.test.mjs packages/cms/tracy-emdash-theme-diner/tests/personalize-imported-pictures.test.mjs
S2: Record the exit code and the '# tests', '# pass', '# fail' lines.
expect: S1 exits 0 with '# fail 0' and '# pass' equal to '# tests' (12): keepImportedPictures gives each seed path the picture whose file name the importer wrote, on a first Apply that moves rows and on the Apply after it; a list spot without a usable name, or a name two source files of the entry share, keeps the source path; on each theme's real seed/media-map.json and seed.json, with the names EmDash's library gives a fresh import in upload order (`intro-3-2.jpg`, `item-1-3.jpg`), every source path at a media-map spot ends with its own picture, rows in seed order and reversed; a whole-seed Restaurant and Diner site keeps every picture after a personalize run with no model and with a model rewriting the rows.
evidence: Review of #572, reproduced on its code: with the site's rows in another order than the seed's after one Apply, the next Apply paired each seed path with the picture at the same row index and wrote the pictures swapped (two-row case: run 1 [b, a], run 2 [a, b]; real seed with lists reversed: 64 Restaurant and 24 Diner spots wrong). JoomlArt-Products/tracy-emdash-template#36 (merge 8d31fd0) matched by the bare file name, which EmDash's findAvailableFilename renames library-wide: on a fresh import 16 Restaurant spots (intro-*.jpg) and 6 Diner spots (item-*.jpg) kept the source path. Fixed by #37 (merge 49829e2).
fence: The write door of the personalize tool (writeEntry → keepImportedPictures): a seed path at a media-map spot is replaced only by the site's picture whose filename is the spot's media-map file name (or that name with the library's -<n> suffix, n >= 2, when it fits no other source file of the entry), or, for a spot in no list, the site's picture at that spot.

tests: keepImportedPictures: a seed picture path the site holds an imported picture for keeps the picture
keepImportedPictures: two Applies that move rows give each path its own picture both times
keepImportedPictures: a list spot whose picture carries no usable name keeps the source path
every seed picture path finds its own picture under the names a fresh import gives the library, rows moved or not
a described restaurant keeps every picture the importer placed, with no model
a described restaurant keeps every picture the importer placed, with a model rewriting the rows
a described business keeps every picture the importer placed, with no model
a described business keeps every picture the importer placed, with a model rewriting the rows
